parsed.reason: The position, the 36 hours and the Wednesday 11:00 p.m. deadline are all correct, and the reminder promise is handed. But the note never says the clock started from the parent's own message at 11:00 a.m. today. It gives no start for the clock at all, and "36 hours to respond to an offer" implies the clock starts when an offer arrives. A waitlisted note with a deadline must give the right start, so this fails that rule.
